system_design_understanding.comment: Exemplary comprehension of composite indexing, EXPLAIN ANALYZE execution plan nodes, sort elimination, keyset pagination, and N+1 query prevention.

implementation_quality.comment: Implemented composite indexes, keyword/tag/status filtering, O(1) keyset pagination, and single-query batch analytics aggregation with strict tenant isolation.

verification_rigor.comment: All 8 automated tests passed in verify_module_08.py; verified 8.6x speedup on listing queries and 15.2x speedup on batch analytics; verified Module 07 idempotency regressions.

tradeoff_analysis.comment: Thoroughly analyzed write amplification, keyset vs offset pagination tradeoffs, and anti-enumeration multi-tenant security.
